descriptions.value: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper authorization via user-controlled keys.

descriptions.description: CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

assertions.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in IBM API Connect

title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in IBM API Connect

descriptions.value: In multiple files, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

supportingMedia.value: Apache TomEE running on JDK 21 or later skips EJB method authorization checks, allowing callers to invoke EJB methods without the configured access restrictions being enforced. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.
